description: Search launch events, newest launch first: a tech company said in public that it launched something usable now (`stage` post) or that it is about to (`stage` pre, what the company said itself, never a prediction). Each record gives the company and its domain, `launch_type` (new_company, new_product, major_version or feature), the product name, `launched_at`, a link to the company's own post or page (`source_url`), the founder or poster as an opaque `person_ref` plus their public name (pass the name and domain to email_find), and the company's `funding` (newest round, count, known total), `company` (HQ, size, industry) and `category`. A record with `duplicate_of` set repeats an earlier launch and is never charged. Page with `cursor`. While GET /pricing does not list this route in its family's available_routes it answers 503 temporarily_unavailable and nothing is charged.

country.description: Headquarters country as a name or ISO code, such as US.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's `next_cursor`.

stage.description: `post` (launched, usable now), `pre` (the company says it is about to launch), or both comma-separated.

name: launch_search
title: Search Company Launches
